evidence: **Body mass/BMI and body fat/WHR: PY.** Dietitians and study staff were unblinded and no assessor blinding is reported (p.1366). **Leptin: NI.** Hospital laboratory immunoassay; blinding not reported. **Oocytes and pregnancy: NI.** The IVF team's blinding is not reported.
guidance: Box 10, 4.3; §7.3 on whether assessors were blinded.

evidence: **Body mass/BMI: PN.** Scale reading involves almost no judgement. **Body fat/WHR: PY.** Caliper skinfolds and tape circumferences depend on the measurer. **Leptin: N.** Automated assay. **Oocytes: PN.** A count of retrieved oocytes. **Pregnancy: PN.** Ultrasound gestational sac.
guidance: Box 10, 4.4: knowledge is "unlikely to influence observer-reported outcomes that do not involve judgement"; §7.1 types 2 and 3.

evidence: **Body fat/WHR: PN.** The changes are large and consistent with the ~4.5 kg weight loss measured objectively on the scale. No indication of strong belief that would push the readings. **All other components: NA.**
guidance: Box 10, 4.5: distinguishes "could have influenced… but there is no reason to believe that it did" (Some concerns) from likely influence (High).

evidence: **Anthropometrics, leptin, oocytes: PN.** All anthropometric variables are reported at the stated 12-week endpoint, including the non-significant waist result (P=0.132). Leptin and oocytes have a single measure each. **Pregnancy: NI.** The registry defines clinical pregnancy two weeks after the IVF cycle. The article reports spontaneous pregnancies during follow-up and does not clearly report IVF-cycle pregnancies (p.1369).
guidance: Box 11, 5.2: NI "if analysis intentions are not available… and there is more than one way in which the outcome domain could have been measured."

evidence: **Anthropometrics and leptin: NI.** Methods say both means and change values were compared "at baseline and postintervention" (p.1368), but only changes are reported. Leptin P is 0.013 in the text and 0.043 in Table 3, which suggests more than one analysis. **Oocytes and pregnancy: PN.** A simple comparison of means or proportions.
guidance: Box 11, 5.3: examples include "final value vs change from baseline"; NI when intentions are unavailable and multiple analyses were possible.
